survived_window.detail: CS did not fail, was not rescued, and no public emergency support is documented for Oct 1-4 2022 (Zurich). Mon Oct 3: CS issued a statement/memo rebutting social-media rumours (capital and liquidity sound). It drew down its own liquidity buffers; legal-entity LCRs dipped below some requirements but group LCR/NSFR stayed compliant (CS Nov 23 2022 update, SEC 6-K). PUK (Dec 20 2024) says CS was close to insolvency with massive liquidity outflows at start of October and authorities switched to crisis mode in October, but no SNB/Confederation rescue occurred then (public SNB support came Mar 2023). Not verified: whether any non-public SNB liquidity facility was used; I found no source saying so.
survived_window.confidence: high on no failure/rescue; medium on no emergency support

best_estimate_oct1_4.derivation: No published 72h figure exists (searched CS filings, FINMA Dec 2023 report page, PUK press release/summary, press). Step 1: Q4 deposits -138bn (~36% of ~385bn). Step 2: October ~60-67% of Q4 outflows; deposits made up the majority of outflows, so October deposit outflow roughly 60-90bn (16-23% of deposits). Step 3: CS says outflows peaked in the first two weeks of October, then eased; Oct 1-2 was a weekend, so only Mon Oct 3 and Tue Oct 4 count (2 of ~10 business days in that period). Assume the rumour-driven first days were front-loaded, taking roughly 20-35% of the October total, giving ~12-30bn, centre ~20bn, i.e. ~5% of deposits (range 2-8%). This is a judgment estimate with no direct source; it could be materially off. Anything above ~10% would imply more than the PUK-reported scale supports for two trading days.

leading_segments: Not reported in detail. CS 4Q22 release: outflows 'across all regions'; mostly Wealth Management (WM AUM outflow ~10% of Q3 AUM by Nov 11; Swiss Bank only ~1%). Finews: CS gave no geographic breakdown but signs Asia contributed; Bloomberg: UBS saw significant APAC wealth inflows from CS clients. No source found for Middle East or institutional leadership in Oct 2022 (Saudi/Middle East attention came in March 2023).
peak_dates: Peak only described as first two weeks of October 2022 (CS statement); outflows 'reduced substantially' by Nov 11 but not reversed; a second wave in late Dec 2022 (PUK: 'beginning of October and again in late December'). Exact peak day not published in sources found; likely Mon Oct 3 - mid Oct (inference). Liquidity stabilised at LCR 120-130% since Oct 27 results.
